happy.title: A pleasant browsing moment
happy.intro: Before the next set, we'll show a short clip from a comedy show used in mood research. Imagine you have also just found a great deal on a watch you love. There is nothing to solve here.
happy.task: Watch the local clip. When the timer ends, continue to the check-in.
happy.blockDebrief: The clip was there to set a mood, not to evaluate you.

frustrated.title: The search that will not cooperate
frustrated.intro: The site's search is being tested and may be unreliable; please try up to three times. It is fine to stop early.
frustrated.task: Search for: a 42 mm automatic dive watch with a blue dial and a titanium strap.
frustrated.afterLastAttempt: That was the last attempt. You can wait for the timer.
frustrated.blockDebrief: The search was designed to fail; it was not your fault. Take a break if you would like one.

confused.title: Which category is right?
confused.intro: We're checking how people categorise a new product; there is no right answer. The labels below overlap and none of them clearly matches the target.
confused.task: Target: a watch that is formal enough for a dinner, but rugged enough for a hike.

categories.label: Outdoor / active
categories.detail: Rugged watches for trail and water

categories.label: Everyday / smart
categories.detail: Versatile watches for work and weekends

confused.blockDebrief: The categories were deliberately ambiguous; there was no correct answer. Take a break if you would like one.

bored.title: The very repetitive catalogue check
bored.intro: Please verify the prices of these identical straps for the catalogue. You do not need to finish, and you may stop early.
bored.task: Verify the price of each strap in the list. The same value repeats.
bored.blockDebrief: The repetitive task was deliberately dull. Stretch or look around before the next block.
